name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | Grape Ape
description: Unleash the bold, fruity power of Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Grape Ape, an indica powerhouse that delivers deep relaxation and rich, grape-forward flavor. Crafted from fresh-frozen cannabis, this live resin wax is packed with terpenes and cannabinoids, offering a smooth and potent dabbing experience. With sweet grape, berry, and earthy undertones, Grape Ape hits with a calming, full-body high that melts away stress and tension. Perfect for evening sessions or unwinding after a long day, this potent indica will leave you feeling blissfully relaxed and sedated.
